text:
sam: quick heads-up — I ran a kernel + quant sweep across p4d, a10g, and g5 for Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B. Focus: rope variant behavior, GQA regression at long context, and latency/throughput tradeoffs. attaching initial notes :chart_with_upwards_trend:

lina: awesome — any obvious perf winners per GPU?

sam: short summary: Mistral low-latency at 2k ctx on all GPUs. Llama2 better throughput with fused_rope on a10g. Qwen stable at <=8k but shows quality drop on q4_0 at 32k (GQA down ~3.2%). full numbers below.

marcus: can you paste the commands you used? want to reproduce in eu-central1.

sam: sure — bench harness snippet:
```
./bench_runner \
  --model $MODEL \
  --kernel $KERNEL \
  --quant $QUANT \
  --ctx $CTX \
  --device $GPU \
  --batch 1 \
  --seq_len_dist uniform
```
Ran each config x5, warmup 200 tokens.

sam: sample outputs (p4d, Llama2-13B, fused_rope, q4_0, ctx=8192):
```
p50: 95ms
p95: 260ms
tokens/s: 380
```

sam: same on a10g (fused_rope) gave p50 82ms p95 190ms tokens/s 520.

anya: interesting — did you try legacy_rope vs fused_rope on Qwen? iirc kernel differences matter for GQA.

sam: yes: Qwen-7B, ctx=32768, q4_0:
- fused_rope: latency p50 720ms p95 1.9s, GQA accuracy drop 3.2%
- legacy_rope: latency p50 980ms p95 2.6s, GQA drop 0.9%
so fused_rope faster but larger quality regression at extreme ctx for q4_0.

lina: that's a great find. suggests kernel/quant interaction. did you test q8_0 or fp16?

sam: q8_0 reduces quality delta but increases latency ~10-15%. fp16 baseline has no regression but costs 2x memory.

marcus: region differences? eu-central vs us-west1?

sam: performance numbers nearly identical for p50 on same GPU class, but we saw higher p95 tail in eu-central (network variance) for hosted endpoints — think it's infra noise, not model. dedicated pools had consistent tails.

qa-bot: automated regression check: new q4_0 + fused_rope + Qwen-7B @ ctx>=24576 flagged: GQA delta -3.2% vs baseline-fp16. See run 1758123456-qa for logs.

marcus: thanks — can you add a small canary rollout rule to avoid q4_0 fused_rope on Qwen in hosted for ctx>8k?

sam: will add to rollout config. proposal: in hosted routing table, for Qwen-7B if ctx>8192 prefer legacy_rope or q8_0.

deploy-bot: rollback rule created: Qwen-7B | ctx>8192 => prefer(legacy_rope,q8_0) ; notified infra.

lina: next steps: 1) reproduce in eu-central dedicated pool, 2) run focused QC eval set for long-context GQA with varying quant, 3) document kernel compatibility notes in onboarding doc. I can take doc.

sam: perfect — I'll upload the raw csvs and latency charts to the bench bucket: gs://redwood-bench/1758123456/ (charts + raw runs). link: https://storage.redwood/bench/1758123456 :thumbsup:

anya: one more ask — capture KV-cache hit behavior in the runs, I suspect fused_rope cache layout triggers quant rounding differences at long ctx.

sam: noted, adding KV cache histograms to the next pass.

marcus: great thread — moving this to eng-ml weekly agenda.
